strategies.name: session_bias_orb_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: First determine directional bias from the 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. one-hour candles: bullish engulfing for longs, bearish engulfing for shorts. Then on the 5-minute New York open, mark the 9:30-9:45 opening range, wait for price to break and close outside the range in the bias direction, and enter on
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the invalidation area for the retracement entry (examples: below the opening range or below demand for longs, above a recent wick for shorts). result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one three-step opening-range breakout retracement scalping skeleton; buy/sell directions and confirmation differences (engulfing confirmation vs passive limit vs classic retest, plus target/management differences) are compatible variants rather than distinct strategies.
